details.problem: The existing backend on AWS Amplify V1 was hindered by versioning conflicts and inefficient resource usage, leading to high operational costs and limitations in functionality.
details.solution: I led a critical system migration to AWS Amplify V2, where I designed and implemented a new set of scalable GraphQL APIs using TypeScript and DynamoDB. This resolved the versioning issues and modernized the backend architecture for better cost-efficiency and performance. The migration involved careful planning to ensure zero downtime and seamless data transfer.

impact.text: Reduction in AWS resource costs (from $800/month to $440/month through optimized Lambda and DynamoDB usage)
Faster deployment cycles (reduced from 15 minutes to 12 minutes per deployment)
Resolution of critical versioning issues (eliminated all 8 blocking dependency conflicts)
